title: Beschaffung einer Software für die KI-gestützte Gutachtenerstellung im medizinischen Fachbereich Behandlungsfehler
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Entwicklung, Implementierung und der Betrieb einer KI-gestützten Assistenzsoftware zur Unterstützung der Begutachtung vermuteter Behandlungsfehler beim Medizinischen Dienst Nordrhein. Die Lösung soll umfangreiche medizinische Unterlagen automatisiert analysieren, relevante Informationen extrahieren und strukturieren, Behandlungsverläufe darstellen, Recherchefunktionen bereitstellen sowie bei der Erstellung von Sachverhaltsdarstellungen und Gutachtenentwürfen unterstützen. Die fachliche Bewertung und Freigabe verbleiben stets bei den Gutachterinnen und Gutachtern; Entwicklung und Betrieb erfolgen unter besonderen Anforderungen an Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit und KI-Regulierung.

title: Lakisääteisten henkilökuljetusten ja kiireettömien potilaskuljetusten hankinta Etelä-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueen palvelutarpeisiin
description: Lakisääteisten henkilökuljetusten ja kiireettömien potilaskuljetusten hankinta Etelä-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueen palvelutarpeisiin Hankintayksikkö pyytää tarjousta Lakisääteisten henkilökuljetusten ja kiireettömien potilaskuljetusten toteutuksesta Etelä-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueen palvelutarpeisiin; Hankinnan tarkoituksena on toteuttaa tilaajalle kokonaisvaltainen henkilökuljetusten ohjauspalvelukokonaisuus, jolla hallitaan erilaisia Tilaajan sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon asiakkaille, työntekijöilleen ja muille sidosryhmilleen (palvelun käyttäjät) järjestämiä henkilökuljetuksia sekä vähäisessä hyvinvointialueen tarpeen mukaisia tavarakuljetuksia silloin, kun ne voidaan toteuttaa henkilökuljetuksiin tarkoitetulla kalustolla. Hankinta jakautuu kahteen ajalliseen ja eri sisältöiseen vaiheeseen; vaihe 1 ja vaihe 2. - Vaiheessa 1 palvelun käyttäjien kuljetukset järjestetään tilaajan kilpailuttamien kuljetuspalveluiden tuottajien (jatkossa autoilijat) ajoneuvoilla ja henkilöstöllä, joita ohjauskeskus ohjaa. Tutustu Liite Palvelukuvaus vaihe 1, joka tarkentaa tätä palvelukuvausta vaiheen 1 osalta. - Vaiheessa 2 palvelun käyttäjien kuljetukset järjestetään ohjauskeskuksen omien tai kilpailuttamien tai alihankkijoiden ajoneuvoilla sekä henkilöstöllä, joita ohjauskeskus ohjaa. Tarjoajan tulee tarjota kokonaisuutta. Osatarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Vaihtoehtoisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Tarjouspyyntöasiakirjat ovat suomen kielellä ja tarjous tulee antaa suomen kielellä. Hankintakokonaisuuden tarkemmat tiedot ja vaatimukset tarjouspyynnössä ja liitteissä, erityisesti Liite Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus ja Liite Vaatimusmäärittely, jossa on ilmoitettu tarjottavien palveluiden vähimmäis- ja laatuvaatimukset. Hankinnassa noudatetaan hankintalakia 1397/2016. Menettelytapana on EU-kynnysarvon ylittävä avoin menettely.,

title: Finland-Helsinki: Telecommunications services
Illumina and PacBio Sequencing of Human and Mouse DNA and RNA
description: The Mechanistic Studies Division (MSD) of Health Canada’s Environmental Health Research and Science Bureau investigates the pathways by which physical, chemical and microbiological agents can cause adverse health effects. To determine how chemical substances cause DNA damage that can lead to illnesses like cancer or inherited diseases, MSD requires high-throughput genome sequencing services utilizing Illumina and Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) platforms. The primary objective of this contract is to secure long-term high-quality sequencing services for pre-prepared DNA libraries and genomic DNA and/or RNA utilizing Illumina or PacBio Revio platforms for the full duration of projects funded until up to 2030-2031. This requirement encompasses the sequencing of multiple mouse and human error-corrected next-generation sequencing (ecNGS) DNA libraries, genomic DNA and/or RNA samples in direct support of four distinct research projects. These projects are distributed across the Division and funded through three separate programs. Collectively, they employ advanced genomic technologies to support public health protection by identifying environmental mutagens, evaluating occupational hazards, and improving toxicological testing methodologies. Specifically, this work will use ecNGS, whole-genome sequencing (WGS), whole-exome sequencing and/or RNA-sequencing approaches to detect and characterize both spontaneous mutations and mutations induced by chemical and environmental exposures in mouse and human DNA as well as gene expression changes. The resulting data will contribute to a better understanding of mutagenic mechanisms, exposure-related genetic damage, and the development of more sensitive and informative approaches for genetic toxicology and human health risk assessment.

title: CHL NBC VE 4754 Pathologie mit Kühlzellen
description: Das Klinikum Centre Hospitalier de Luxembourg beabsichtigt im Zuge des Neubaus einige Pathologieeinrichtung gemäß dem Vergabeverfahren „Buch II Offenes Verfahren (Loi, Art. 63 und 65)" zu beschaffen. Bestandteil der Ausschreibung ist die Lieferung und Montage von - 1 Leichenkühlzellenanlage mit Einzelfächern für 21 Verstorbenen (davon 3 Plätze adipöse) - 1 Leichenkühlzellenanlage für 1 radioaktive Verstorbenen - 18 Leichenmulde Standardgröße - 3 Leichenmulde Adipositas-Größe - 1 Leichenmulde Standardgröße für radioaktive Verstorbene - 1 Wasch- und Seziertisch fahrbar mit Schnittstelle Andockstation - 1 Andocksäule für fahrbaren Seziertisch - 1 Seziertisch, fahrbar für die Entnahme der Hornhäute - 1 Scherenwagen für Sargtransport - 3 Hydraulischer Leichenmulden-Hubwagen für Standardgröße und adipöse Verstorbene - 1 Katafalkrahmen, fahrbar, mit Kühlung inkl. Behang und Mulde - 1 Gefriertruhe für Körperteile mit Temperaturüberwachung - 2 Standleuchter (Elektrokerzen) Die Lieferung und Montage der Bestandteile soll nach dem folgenden Prioritäten-Schema getrennt ablaufen: Montage Unterkonstruktionen, Montage Leichenkühlzellanlagen, Lieferung Zubehör unmittelbar vor Inbetriebnahme (Diebstahlprävention). 1 Haupt- und 1 Nachbesserungstermin sind mit dem Angebotspreis abgegolten, wobei die Teilleistungen gemäß Terminplan gestaffelt einzutakten und mit der örtlichen Bauleitung/Fachbauleitung abzustimmen sind. Die gesetzliche Verjährungsfrist der Gewährleistungsansprüche beginnt mit der Abnahme der Leistung. Der Tag der Abnahme (komplette Montage inklusive Mängelbeseitigungen) ist der Gewährleistungsbeginn. Folgende Leistungen sind neben den gerätebezogenen Leistungen anzubieten und zu kalkulieren: - Bei der Kollisionsprüfung durch den koordinierenden Architekten (4Bund) ist durch den Auftragnehmer (AN) mitzuwirken. Die Montagepläne sind bei Erfordernis anzupassen. - Für Organisationsbesprechungen - auch teil- und abschnittsweise - hat der AN einen mit der Anlage in allen Teilen technisch und betrieblich vertrauten, sachkundigen Mitarbeiter beizustellen. - Weitere Leitungen gemäß den zusätzlichen technischen Vorbemerkungen der Medizintechnik. Eignungskriterien gemäß allgemeinen und besonderen Vertragsbedingungen, Punkt 1.10 / Punkt 2.10 Für die Lieferungen und Montagen der Geräte sind folgende Termine maßgebend: Möglicher Beginn Einbau: 24.09.2027 Spätester Abschluss Montagen: 29.03.2029 (Innenausbau + Technik gem. Generalablaufplan_V5) Unter Berücksichtigung des Starttermins ist ein Montageterminplan vorzulegen und ggf. an Vorgaben des Architekten (4Bund) anzupassen. Die jeweils für die Einbringung und Montage benötigten Zeiten sind pro Gerät zu hinterlegen.

Le marché comprend notamment la fourniture de la solution, son intégration dans l’environnement existant, la reprise et la migration progressive des certificats internes et publics, ainsi que les prestations de configuration, documentation, formation, transfert aux opérations, support et maintenance.

description: This is a project supported by PEACEPLUS, a programme managed by the Special EU Programmes Body (SEUPB). title: Cycle d’orientation de la Golette Réaménagement et végétalisation des espaces extérieurs
description:
Les travaux concernés par le présent appel d'offres portent sur le centre du préau du CO de la Golette ainsi que sur le parvis d'entrée. Situés à proximité immédiate des entrées principales du cycle, les travaux seront organisés par étapes afin de garantir la sécurité et l’évacuation des élèves et des enseignant·e·s. Le chantier se déroulera majoritairement en site occupé, ce qui impliquera une coordination rigoureuse avec les activités scolaires en cours.


Le présent marché porte sur les travaux principaux suivants :

• Installations de chantier ;

• Travaux préparatoires, démolitions et déposes soignées de revêtements et mobiliers ;

• Terrassement, notamment des interventions spécifiques aux pieds d’arbres existants ;

• Réalisation de fosse de type Stockholm et de fosses en pleine terre ;

• Réalisation de buttes paysagères ;

• Réalisation et adaptation des réseaux nécessaires à la gestion des eaux en faveurs des

surfaces plantées ;

• Réalisation et adaptation des revêtements de sol ;

• Mise en place de nouveaux équipements et mobiliers ;

• Pose de nouveaux couverts (sous réserve de la réalisation de couverts intégrant des matériaux

de réemploi par une entreprise spcéialisée et mandatée à part) ;

• Plantations d’arbres, d’arbustes, de vivaces et travaux d’ensemencement ;

• Entretien et garantie des plantations sur 3 années selon les prescriptions du présent dossier.

description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION Medically Managed Intensive Residential Withdrawal Management (IIWM) Services The Court Services and Offender Supervision Agency (CSOSA) is conducting market research to identify qualified sources capable of providing Medically Managed Intensive Residential Withdrawal Management (IIWM) services for individuals referred by CSOSA. The Government seeks information regarding industry capability, facility capacity, clinical and medical staffing, licensing and accreditation, geographic availability, transportation, transition planning, performance measurement, and potential pricing approaches. The anticipated acquisition would include one 12-month base period and four 12-month option periods, for a potential total period of performance of 60 months. Responses will help CSOSA assess the availability of responsible sources, consider an appropriate acquisition strategy, refine performance requirements, and determine whether a small-business set-aside or another socioeconomic strategy is suitable.

title: Denison Valve Replacement
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Tulsa District has been tasked to solicit for and award a contract for providing and installing two new 8-inch station service draft tube drain gate valves and two new 16-inch unwatering gate valves at Denison Dam Powerhouse. The work will include the removal and disposal of the existing valves, as well as the inspection and refurbishment of existing valves operating equipment, including stem extensions, shafts, bearings, bushings, and associated components. The work will be performed in a confined space within a manhole approximately 30 feet deep, requiring specialized access, lifting equipment, and appropriate safety measures. The type of set-aside decision to be issued will depend upon the capabilities of the responses to this synopsis.

title: Jacksonville Harbor Maintenance Dredging
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Enterprise Dredge Delivery Center (EDDC) requires a contract to provide maintenance dredging for Jacksonville Harbor. Jacksonville Harbor: The Jacksonville Harbor, FL - FY27 O and M Contract (non-fed sponsor Jacksonville Port Authority (JAXPORT)) for maintenance dredging typically requires hopper and pipeline/mechanical dredge(s) depending on work location in the~ 20-mile federal channel. The dredge(s) must have the capability to dredge maintenance material up to a depth of -47 ft MLLW (w/additional depths for required advanced maintenance areas and allowable over depths) and to transport the dredged sediment to both a designated Dredged Material Placement Area (DMPA) known as Bartram Island and the Ocean Dredge Material Disposal Site (ODMDS) located approximately 6 nautical miles offshore. Dredged material shall be placed upland in Bartram Island Cell F and the Jacksonville ODMDS Release Zone C1 depending on the specific reach to be dredged. The transport distance to the designated placement areas varies significantly, ranging from direct, local placement to a few miles for the upland placement area and up to 6 miles for ocean disposal from the tip of the south jetty. The work is divided into a base and five options. The Contractor shall be required to (a) commence work under this contract within ten (10) calendar days after the date the Contractor receives the notice to proceed, (b) prosecute the work diligently, and (c) complete the entire work ready for use not later than 220 days after the Contractor receives the notice to proceed. The time stated for completion shall include final cleanup of the premises. Base: 120 calendar days. Option A: 15 calendar days. Option B: 20 calendar days. Option C: 30 calendar days. Option D: 25 calendar days. Option E: 10 calendar days. Complete all work within Cut-17 Sta. 0+00 through Cut-41 Sta. 20+00 (BASE work), which are located within an Outstanding Florida Waters (OFW), no later than May 20, 2027.This solicitation is unrestricted. title: Construction Services for Confined Aquatic Disposal Cell Construction and Maintenance Dredging of the Providence River Federal Navigation Project, Providence, Rhode Island.
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District is issuing a Sources Sought Announcement for the upcoming dredging project located in Providence, Rhode Island. This announcement is to determine the interest, availability and capability of Small and Large Business concerns as described below. The NAICS code for this procurement is 237990. The solicitation for this project is anticipated to be issued on or about 15 March 2027. The construction will begin in September 2027 and is expected to take approximately 2 years to complete. The estimated construction cost is between $80,000,000 and $100,000,000. The Providence River Maintenance Dredging project involves two major sequences of dredging and disposal activities. The first work sequence will be the construction of a new Confined Aquatic Disposal (CAD) cell adjacent to the Providence River. The second work sequence under this contract will include maintenance dredging of the Providence River and Harbor Federal Navigation Project (FNP) to its authorized depths and dimensions. The proposed work consists of mechanically dredging approximately 5,500,000 cubic yards (cy) of material using closed clamshell buckets for both major sequences of work over the course of two years. The new CAD cell will be in the Edgewood Basin area located adjacent to the Providence FNP (hereafter the �Edgewood Shoals North (ESN) CAD cell�). To access the CAD cell area, an access channel will be dug between the Providence FNP and the CAD cell area. The access channel will be approximately 100 ft wide and -25 MLLW deep. The CAD cell will have surface dimensions of approximately 1000 ft. by 1000 ft. and be dug to a depth of -60 MLLW. The material excavated to build the access channel is generally a mix of sandy silt and shell fragments. Within the CAD cell area the material is generally described as soft grey to black organic silt with some layers of firm sandy silt and some shell fragments and coarse-grained material. Material excavated from the access channel and CAD cell area will be placed at four locations: Port Edgewood Basin, the Fox Point Reach CAD cells, Prudence Island Disposal Site, and the Rhode Island Sound Disposal Site. This work consists of mechanically dredging approximately 3,200,000 cy to construct thew ESN CAD cell and its access channel, which must be completed before maintenance dredging of the FNP can begin. The maintenance dredging proposed work consists of mechanically dredging the Providence River FNP to the full -40 MLLW depth plus 2-feet of allowable overdepth. 2,300,000 cy (1,200,000 cy required depth, with up to 1,100,000 cy overdepth) of shoaled material consisting generally of poorly graded medium to fine sand with silt. The dredge material from this maintenance portion of work will be placed in the ESN CAD cell. Environmental coordination and permitting is being completed by the U.S. Army of Engineers, New England District. All dredging and disposal activities for this project have prescribed work windows that incorporate environmental and recreational time of year restrictions. Refer to the Draft Specification Section provided with this announcement for specifics on the time of year work restrictions. In order to accomplish all dredging requirements within the specified dredging window it is expected that the Contractor will need to meet a production rate of 300,000 CY per 30 calendar days. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District is requesting responses to the questions below from both small and large businesses[MC1] . Draft drawings showing a concept design plan and draft Specification Section of 01 11 00 SUMMARY OF WORK have been provided with this announcement to help provide more context for the contract work and responses to these questions. Considering the different disposal locations, are there suggestions on a bid structure that will provide for the most accurate costs of different disposal locations? Any draft restrictions that may impact dredging and/or disposal operations? Any concerns on the period of performance of September 2027 to September 2029 considering the environmental windows and amount of work? If so, why? Any comments about the bed leveling planned in the Fox Point Reach? Are there concerns about this part of the plan, if so, why? Interested firms should also demonstrate their project experience, by providing two (2) projects within the last ten years, which meet the following requirements: Dredging by mechanical means demonstrating a minimum production rate of 300,000 cubic yards in one consecutive 30-day period. Experience with placement of dredged material at an open water placement site in New England during the fall/winter months of October through March. Interested firms should submit a capabilities package to include the following: business classification (i.e. HUBZone, etc.), type of equipment the firm is proposing to use on the project, and two (2) example projects performed by the firm in the last ten (10) years (including Points of Contact for those projects) showing experience with the proposed equipment at the production rate listed above. Please indicate the team subcontractor(s) (if any), including their prior experience and qualifications meeting the same qualifications listed above, which will be used to support the bidder's effort. Firms may use subcontractor experience to demonstrate experience with the requirements, but the role and work performed by each team member (prime and subcontractors) on projects demonstrating that team member's experience shall be the same as the role for that team member for this project. Bid bond will need to be provided with the bid. Responses are limited to twenty pages and due by December 03 , 2026. Responses should be addressed to the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District, 696 Virginia Road, Concord, MA 01742-2751, ATTN: Kyle Hall, or electronically to Kyle.K.Hall@usace.army.mil. The Government will not pay for any material provided in response to this market survey nor return the data provided. This notice is for information purposes only and is not a request to be placed on a solicitation mailing list nor is it a Request for Proposal (RFP) or an announcement of a solicitation. The results of this survey will be considered to be in effect for a period of one year from the date of this notice. description: Login at https://piee.eb.mil and search for 'FA821426RB002' to obtain more details.* Documents related to this procurment are only available through PIEE. 1. Executive Summary: Background & Objective The U.S. Air Force has a critical requirement to support the Minuteman III (MMIII) Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) by maintaining the operational readiness of the Missile Guidance Set (MGS) to meet warfighter requirements. Specifically, this effort supports the repair line for the Pendulous Integrated Gyroscopic Accelerometer (PIGA) Float Assembly. The PIGA Float is a critical and precise sub-assembly that serves as the heart of the PIGA instrument, enabling it to measure missile acceleration. Each MGS contains three separate PIGA instruments (each housing a PIGA Float). Without this critical component, the ICBM would cease to function properly. The PIGA Float repair effort is a continuous operation necessary to avoid mission degradation. Quality control and precision engineering are paramount due to the strategic importance of the MMIII weapon system. The contractor must maintain stringent quality assurance protocols to guarantee that each repaired PIGA Float meets the rigorous military specifications. 2. Scope of Work The contractor shall provide the necessary personnel, facilities, and expertise to support the PIGA Float Assembly repair line. The primary scope includes: Repair Operations - The re-manufacture, rebuild, and repair of PIGA Float Assemblies. Volume / Throughput - The repair of 96 PIGA Floats per year. Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) - The repair and/or replacement of GFE as required to support continuous operation of the PIGA Float repair line 3. Contract Structure & Period of Performance The Government anticipates awarding an Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract utilizing a mix of Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF) and Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) pricing arrangements. Contract Duration - 5-Year IDIQ Anticipated Ordering Period - 1 November 2026 � 31 October 2031 Task Order Structure - Annual issuance of new, two-year non-severable Task Orders 4. Acquisition Authority & Strategy In accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 5.1, this solicitation is an intended sole-source procurement. The Government will solicit and negotiate with only one source: Honeywell Aerospace (CAGE: 09128). This action is taken under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by RFO 6.103-1. Market research�including Sources Sought Synopsis FA821425CBPIGA (posted 29 May 2025)�concluded that Honeywell Aerospace is the only responsible source capable of fulfilling the Government�s requirement without causing unacceptable delays to the MMIII weapon system mission. Note: While this is not a request for competitive proposals, information received from other responsible sources identifying their interest and capability will be considered solely to determine whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future, at the Government�s discretion. 5. Proposal Submission Instructions All proposals submitted in response to this solicitation must be submitted electronically through the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) Solicitation Module. No other methods of proposal submission (e.g., email, hard copy, DoD SAFE) will be accepted. Offerors must be registered in PIEE and have the appropriate roles activated to submit proposals via the Solicitation module prior to the proposal due date. Cost & Pricing Data: The Government requests that ProPricer models (version v9.5.105.2) be submitted in conjunction with all Certified Cost and Pricing Data. Mandatory Pricing Rubric: Submission of the attached Pricing Rubric is a mandatory requirement. Proposals submitted without a completed Pricing Rubric will be automatically rejected by the PIEE solicitation module and will not be considered for evaluation. Submission Cutoff: Proposals will not be accepted after the solicitation closes. Timely submission is the sole responsibility of the offeror, and late proposals will not be evaluated unless otherwise stated under RFO guidelines.

title: PUBLIC WORKS ENERGY A-E SERVICES CONTRACTS
description: This SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT is a Market Survey for written information only. This is not a solicitation announcement for proposals and no contract will be awarded from this announcement. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this announcement or any follow-up information requests. There is no bid package or solicitation. The Naval Facilities Engineering Command Engineering and Expeditionary Warfare Center (NAVFAC EXWC), Port Hueneme, CA is conducting a market survey and seeking sources for an Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ), Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Single Award Contract; Architectural and Engineering firms that are capable of performing architect-engineer and design services for Energy Efficiency projects and services to shore facilities and utility systems at various locations, worldwide. The architect-engineer and engineering services may require expertise in installation and facility energy, water, and utility systems, with supporting architectural, mechanical, electrical, civil, structural, and environmental discipline as it pertains to Department of War (DoW) utility systems and energy consuming systems within the naval shore infrastructure. This is a follow-on requirement to contract N39430-23-D-4051, previously awarded to CH2M Hill Clark Nexsen Energy Partners JV. Award is anticipated to be made by June 2028. Security Requirements: Task Orders (TOs) issued under this contract may require performance at locations with security protocols more restrictive than the baseline contract requirements. For those locations, additional personnel information may be required before site access will be authorized for the team members assigned to the TO. The purpose of thus sources sought synopsis is to obtain additional information from interested/qualified sources. The applicable NAICS code is 541330 Engineering Services, with a size standard of $25.5M. The applicable Product Service Code is C219 Architect and Engineering � General: Other. Firms should also list whether it has a facilities clearance, and if not, would be able and willing to obtain a facilities clearance. Comments on the SAES are welcome. Response can be emailed to the contract specialize and contracting officer. At a minimum, provide the following information in your submittal: 1. Name and address of company and contact information/point of contact. 2. CAGE code and Unique Entity ID (UEI): 3. A brief statement of qualifications (not to exceed seven (7) total pages) to include experience relative to this procurement, or any other information that clearly demonstrates your capabilities, expertise and experience to perform the requirements listed in the attached Statement of Architect-Engineering Services (SAES). General marketing material may be included but must fall within the seven (7) page submittal requirement. Firms should provide the approximate number of personnel that are available to perform the work required and the size status in comparison to the NAICS code. 4. Statement as to small business program size status to the above NAICS Code and identification of any existing contract vehicles currently in place which may be used and fit the proposed contract scope. 5. Possible teaming arrangements: If you are responding as a prime contractor, provide anticipated subcontractors and their business size under the identified NAICS code. If you are responding as any other business or teaming entity, please identify the entity and the business size under the NAICS code, if known (e.g., Partnership, Joint Venture, LLC). This sources sought synopsis does not constitute a Request for Quotation (RFQ), Request for Proposal (RFP), or an Invitation for Bid (IFB), and is not to be considered as a commitment by the Government for any purpose other than market research, nor does issuance restrict the Governments acquisition approach. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the evaluation. The Government recognizes that proprietary data may be a part of your submittal. If so, clearly mark such restricted or proprietary data and present it as an addendum to the non-restricted/non-proprietary information. All submittals received will be reviewed for informational purposes. The Government reserves the right to independently verify all information submitted. Notifications of interest must be submitted in writing via email; phone calls will not be accepted. Notifications that do not address all the required information will not be considered. Interested parties should respond as soon as possible but no later than 1200 (Noon) Pacific Standard Time 03 December 2026. Responses to this Sources Sought Notice shall be emailed to the following points of contact: Contract Specialist Emily Rummell at emily.r.rummell.civ@us.navy.mil Contracting Officer Anthony Gonzales at anthony.j.gonzales104.civ@us.navy.mil

title: Mission Module Engineering and Technical Services
description: **ONLY SEAPORT MAC HOLDERS ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AWARD UNDER THIS SOLICITATION.*** Request for Proposal (RFP) (N6133127R0006) under the Seaport NxG Multiple Award Contract (MAC), for Mission Module Engineering and Technical Support. This effort has been previously been posted under the Opportunities page as the following: Sources Sought Notice (N6133126SNQ27), dated (Posted 7 May 2026) and the follow-up Advance Planning Notice/Pre-Solicitation Notice dated (16 June 2026). ***RESPONSES MUST BE SUBMITTED VIA THE PIEE SOLICITATION MODULE.*** ***ALL DOCUMENTS ARE AVAILABLE WITHIN THE PIEE SOLICITATION MODULE*** Questions and Answers WILL TAKE PLACE THROUGH PIEE MODULE AND POSTED TO PIEE SOLICITATION MODULE BY ATTACHMENT***This is a solicitation for SEAPORT MAC HOLDERS ONLY. This solicitation is to provide services to support the Naval Surface Warfare Center Panama City Division (NSWC PCD) Modular Integration Division as the lead for engineering, analysis, and planning support for the modularization of off-board systems in support of the littoral warfare mission area. The requirements will include systems engineering, packaging and handling of off-board system hardware, system integration of legacy and emerging littoral mission systems, sea frame integration of mission modules, development of mission system common computing environments (e.g. Mission Package Computing Environment (MPCE)) and integrated communications networks (e.g. Multiple Vehicle Communication System(MVCS)), distributed engineering testing, and supporting the Government in validation and verification. Specifically, these requirements include the general program, engineering, technical, and integrated logistics support requirements for the Littoral Combat Ship (LCS)Mission Modules (MM) program at NSWC PCD. Access to the solicitation is through the link. Access to the attachments are in the PIEE SOLICITATION MODULE through the link. The Solicitation number for Mission Module Engineering and Technical Support is not N6133126R3111. The correct Solicitation number for Mission Module Engineering and Technical Support is N6133127R0006.

title: LOWER BRULE NORTH SHORELINE STABILIZATION AND ECOSYSTEM RESTORATION, ELEMENT 2
description: The project is located along the left descending bank of Lake Sharpe near the Lower Brule, SD town site. Lower Brule North Element 2 includes a 100-foot-wide riparian planting bench, a gravel maintenance path along the entire reach, a riprap revetment to protect the shoreline and island from erosion, and the creation of a 200-by-1,500-foot island constructed in water up to three feet deep. The sheltered open water area between the island and the shoreline will develop into approximately 5.17 acres of emergent wetland, and this will also create approximately 32 acres of riparian habitat. Related tasks include earth moving, grading, bank shaping, rock installation, water management, fill, and topsoil placement.

title: Air Force Contract Augmentation Program (AFCAP) VI
description: The 772nd Enterprise Sourcing Squadron (772 ESS/PKD) is issuing this solicitation for the Air Force Contract Augmentation Program VI (AFCAP VI). This is a Multiple-Award Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract designed to provide rapid, global contingency planning, logistics, and emergency construction capabilities to the Department of the Air Force, other DoD components, and Federal agencies. The AFCAP serves as a responsive, global force multiplier for commanders and Government agencies, supporting contingencies both within the contiguous United States (CONUS) and outside the contiguous United States (OCONUS).The AFCAP supports United States (U.S.) national interests and security objectives by providing rapid-response capabilities for contingency planning, deployment, training/equipping of forces, emergency/contingency construction, logistics/commodities, and services. These capabilities align with definitions in the DOD Dictionary of Military and Associated Terms. AFCAP provides a full range of Base Operating/Life Support (BOS/BLS) and logistical support on an as-required basis to support a wide spectrum of activities, including, but are not limited to: Major Theater War(s); Small Scale Contingencies; Irregular Warfare; responses to Violent Extremist Organizations (VEO); foreign assistance, developmental assistance, humanitarian assistance, and security assistance (including Foreign Military Sales); peacekeeping; counterinsurgency, counterdrug and counterterrorism operations; maritime security operations; recovery operations and denial measures; domestic/international emergency support; infrastructure/facility design/build, design/build/operate, demolition, and site restoration; deliberate and crisis action planning; and military exercises (including Joint Chiefs of Staff sponsored) authorized by the National Command Authority.

title: Weapons Shipping Harness Refurbishment Blanket Purchase Agreement
description: This is a limited sources combined synopsis/solicitation for services prepared in accordance with simplified acquisition procedures found in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Revolutionary Far Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 13.2, effective 1 February 2026, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation/notice; further written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation Number N6278927Q0001 is issued as a Request for Quotes (RFQ). The solicitation and incorporated provisions and clauses are in effect through the most current Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01 with an effective date of 13 March 2026. The Product and Service Code (PSC) is J019. The North American Industry Classification (NAICS) code is 336419. Supervisor of Shipbuilding Conversion and Repair, Groton CT (SSGR) intends to enter into a multiple award Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA), for a period of 5 years. The vendor shall refurbish weapon Shipping Harnesses in accordance with the attached specification. The Period of Performance shall be 27 January 2027 to 26 January 2032. Each BPA will have up to a five (5) year ordering period with a ceiling of up to $500,000. The BPA Call Limit will be $100,000. The ceiling of each agreement can be increased or decreased at any time by the Contracting Officer via bilateral modification to meet current and future requirements. Funding is not assigned to the BPA. The Government will only be obligated to the extent of calls placed against an awarded BPA. Each BPA call will be competed among the agreement holders as requirements arise. A call will then be placed based on the quote that is most advantageous to the Government. Offerors must provide a description of their property management system per FAR 45.201(c)(4) or confirmation of a property management system that has been reviewed and approved per DFARS 242.302 and meets the requirements of FAR 52.245-1(f). Offerors shall submit a pricing schedule that covers each year of the Period of Performance as follows: Fiscal Year Service Unit Unit Price Amount 2027 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2028 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2029 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2030 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2031 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX Quotations are due prior to 4:00PM EST, 3 December 2026. Late submissions will not be accepted. Offers should be submitted via electronic commerce. The electronic address for receipt of offers is: kyle.r.berg3.civ@us.navy.mil and stephanie.l.neale.civ@us.navy.mil. Offerors should identify the RFQ number in the Subject Line of the email. Offerors are advised to submit electronic documents early and confirm successful transmission/receipt. The System for Award Management (SAM) is a Government maintained database of companies wanting to do business with the Government. A firm must register and maintain an active SAM registration in order to receive a federal award. Register at: https://sam.gov/SAM/pages/public/index.js EVALUATION FACTORS FOR AWARD: The Government intends to enter into a multiple award Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA), for a period of 5 years. Each BPA call will be competed among the agreement holders as requirements arise. The Government will make award(s) to the offeror(s) that represent the best value to the Government based on the following factors, in order: -Technical Qualifications/Ability to meet schedule -Past Performance -Price The Government intends to evaluate proposals and award a contract without discussions with offerors. However, the Government reserves the right to conduct discussions if later determined by the Contracting Officer to be necessary. The Government reserves the right to award one line, all line items, or any combination thereof. If multiple line items are awarded, cost/prices for each line item will be totaled and the award amount will be based on that total. See Section M of the solicitation for additional details.

title: Hankintailmoitus: LapIT Oy:n vakuutusturvan hankinnan kilpailutus
description: Hankintailmoitus: LapIT Oy:n vakuutusturvan hankinnan kilpailutus LapIT Oy (myöhemmin Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia vakuutusturvasta ja siihen liittyvistä palveluista tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. LapIT Oy:n vakuutusturva ja sen laajuus on kuvattu tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Ensimmäinen vakuutuskausi on 1.1.2027-31.12.2027. Tämän jälkeen vakuutuskausi on kalenterivuosi. Tarjous jätetään alkaen täydestä kalenterivuodesta (2027). LapIT Oy:llä on oikeus vakuutuskausien aikana kilpailuttaa vakuutukset uudelleen ja siirtää vakuutukset kilpailutuksen voittajalle. Vakuutukset ovat voimassa toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Hankinnan sopimuskausi on kolme (3) vuotta, jonka jälkeen LapIT Oy:llä on oikeus jatkaa sopimuskautta yhdellä (1) kahden (2) vuoden optiokaudella. Optiokauden jälkeen LapIT Oy:llä on oikeus jatkaa hankintaa toistaiseksi voimassa olevana optiokautena. Lisähankintamahdollisuus: LapIT Oy varaa oikeuden laajentaa sopimusta, mikäli se perustuu hankintamenettelyn aikana tiedossa olleisiin ja hankinta-asiakirjoissa mainittuihin sopimusehtoihin tai niiden muuttamista koskeviin ehtoihin, niiden rahallisesta arvosta riippumatta, ja nämä ehdot ovat selkeät, täsmälliset ja yksiselitteiset, eivätkä ne muuta hankintasopimuksen yleistä luonnetta (1397/2016, 14 luku, 136 §, 2 mom., 1 kohta); tai mikäli alkuperäisen sopimuskumppanin on tarpeen suorittaa lisätöitä tai -palveluja taikka ylimääräisiä tavarantoimituksia, jotka eivät sisältyneet alkuperäiseen sopimukseen, ja jos sopimuskumppanin vaihtaminen ei ole mahdollista taloudellisista tai teknisistä syistä ja aiheuttaisi merkittävää haittaa tai kustannusten merkittävää päällekkäisyyttä hankintayksikölle (1397/2016, 14 luku, 136 §, 2 mom., 2 kohta). LapIT Oy on pohjoissuomalainen ICT -infra ja perustietotekniikan palveluita omistajilleen tuottava in-house -yhtiö. Omistajiimme kuuluu pohjoisen Suomen kuntia, hyvinvointialueita, kunta- ja hyvinvointialueyhtymiä sekä kuntaomisteisia osakeyhtiötä. title: Geostationary extReme UltraViolet Imager (GRUVI), Instrument Request for Information
description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. NO PROPOSALS ARE TO BE SUBMITTED IN RESPONSE TO THIS NOTICE. This RFI seeks information from industry regarding capabilities, interest, and options for providing a solar observing Space Weather (SW) Next Geostationary extReme UltraViolet Imager (GRUVI) Instrument for a future operational NOAA Space weather mission that can resolve solar features, including coronal holes, filaments and prominences, active regions, coronal mass ejections (CMEs), and X10 Class solar flares which will be used by the National Weather Service and the NOAA Space Weather Predication Center to generate and provide Space Weather forecasts and alerts. Solar GRUVI imagery will provide comprehensive situational awareness of the inner solar corona. Although there is no requirement for the number of GRUVI spectral bands, bands will be selected that are sensitive to different plasma temperatures within the range specified for feature and phenomenological discrimination. It is anticipated that at the conclusion of this Phase A study any industry partner will be prepared to enter directly into a System Requirements Review (SRR), approximately one month after Implementation contract award, followed by a Preliminary Design Review (PDR). The capabilities required to perform this Phase A Study for the GRUVI instrument are not currently within the NASA/NOAA workforce, thus the government requires contractor support to perform this study. It is the plan that in the future the capabilities being sought by the RFI will be identified in house, which would allow the government to leverage using our own work force. In addition this RFI will allow the Government to assess contractor capability to manufacture the GRUVI instrument. The Government anticipates multiple awards for the Formulation/Risk reduction phase of the contract. Further, since this is planned to be a fixed price contract the government may authorize the use of priced, or unpriced option to add additional scope or extend the period of performance should the RFI result in the formation of the contract for the GRUVI instrument. The only unique attribute is that the Government will consider a pre-priced option proposed by a contractor to retire additional implementation risk. All responses, comments and/or questions shall be submitted electronically via email to Kelly Lytton at kelly.r.lytton@nasa.gov no later than 5:00pm EDT December 3, 2026.

title: Tactical Communication Systems - Procurement, Services & Sustainment (TCS-PSS) Call for Solutions
description: Project Title: Tactical Communication Systems Procurement, Services & Sustainment (TCS-PSS) Reference Number: CSO-ARMY-TCS-PSS-2027 Primary NAICS: 334220 � Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing 1. Opportunity Overview The Department of the Army, representing the Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN), the Project Manager Command and Control Transport (PM C2T), and the Product Manager Tactical Communication Systems (PdM TCS), has issued a Call for Solutions (CfS) under Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) Part 212.70 to establish a 10-year enterprise acquisition framework for innovative tactical communication capabilities. This initiative seeks to secure a mix of single-award Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts and/or Other Transactions (OTs) to streamline the procurement, testing, fielding, and lifecycle sustainment of both legacy systems and emerging transport hardware and software. Focused on supporting Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2), the effort aims to deliver highly secure�National Security Agency (NSA) High Assurance certified or Sensitive but Unclassified - Encrypted (SBU-E) qualified�resilient, and interoperable communication systems. To counter future cryptographic threats, the framework is seeking capable vendors to provide a plan for incorporating Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) compliant algorithms and achieving National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) validation by 31 December 2030, ensuring robust data protection and mission command resilience in contested joint and coalition environments. 2. title: Sources Sought for F15E Grip Assembly Left Hand Controller and F15E Grip Assembly Right Hand Controller
description: SUBJECT: Market research is being conducted to identify potential sources that may possess the expertise, capabilities, and experience to meet the requirements for qualification and production of the F15E Grip Assembly Left Hand Controller NSN 1290-01-407-5343FX, PN 707-7010 and F15E Grip Assembly Right Hand Controller NSN 1290-01-407-3205FX, PN 707-7011. PR FD2060-26-00048. ITEM DESCRIPTION The left and right hand controllers provide an electrical interface with several systems by means of buttons and switches on a practical, centralized, hand grip. A hand grip style is used, usually of pistol grip design, and is designed to be mounted in the sighting station of the F-15E. It incorporates electrical controls for remotely actuating firing and/or sighting movement of a machine gun(s), grenade launcher(s), rocket launcher(s), and the like, or a combination thereof. Impediment to Competition The original equipment manufacturer for this item is Mason Electric Company (CAGE 81579), which maintains its configuration by part number. The Government does not own any data, drawings, schematics, or any other releasable technical data in support of this requirement. As a result, Mason Electric Company is the only source currently known with adequate knowledge of the F15E Grip Assembly Left/Right Hand Controller performance requirements and possession of the required technical data and capabilities needed to produce this item and ensure compatibility of the equipment. INTEREST Interested parties may identify their interest and capability to respond to the requirement no later than December 3, 2026 to dla.dlr.proc@us.af.mil. The Government intends to procure these items using Full and Open Competition as prescribed by FAR 6.102. DISCLAIMER This sources sought synopsis is for informational purposes only. This is not a request for proposal. It does not constitute a solicitation, and shall not be construed as a commitment by the government. Responses in any form are not offers, and the government is under no obligation to award a contract as a result of this announcement. No funds are available to pay for preparation of responses to this announcement. Any information submitted by respondents to this technical description is strictly voluntary.

title: Replacement purchase of ICT client hardware of the Dübendorf primary school
description:
Dübendorf Elementary School is procuring new ICT devices for students and staff as part of a one-time purchase. The request for proposals is divided into two lots. For each lot, the scope of services includes a one-time delivery of the devices to a central location at Dübendorf Elementary School (delivery to the classroom), unpacking including proper disposal of packaging materials, handling warranty and repair requests via a service desk, and ensuring the availability of functionally equivalent models throughout the service life. The standard 24-month warranty is included in the device price; additional warranty options must be included in the bid. Delivery is scheduled for summer 2027. No master agreement will be entered into.


The quantities specified in the request for proposals are maximum quantities and are considered estimates in accordance with Art. 35(c) of the IVöB. The contracting authority reserves the right to procure only a portion of the services after the contract is awarded (Art. 35(q) of the IVöB). The open-book principle applies to hardware.

title: Ponte Rià de la Molera
description:
La strada italiana H13 costituisce, nel tratto in corrispondenza della località di Sorte, un’importante infrastruttura viaria interessata dalle misure di protezione contro le piene, deliberate in seguito agli eventi alluvionali del giugno 2024.

In tale contesto, al fine di migliorare la sicurezza idraulica della zona e garantire un adeguato deflusso delle acque in caso di piena, è prevista la realizzazione di un nuovo manufatto di attraversamento idraulico lungo la strada italiana, nelle vicinanze di Sorte.

Il nuovo manufatto è destinato a garantire il deflusso delle acque in caso di sovraccarico del sistema esistente, mentre, in condizioni normali, il deflusso continuerà ad avvenire nell’alveo attuale.

Il nuovo ponte «Ponte Rià de la Molera» costituisce parte integrante del nuovo manufatto di attraversamento idraulico previsto a Sorte e consente il superamento dello stesso da parte del traffico stradale.

title: Rammeaftale om flytteydelser
description: Udbudsprocessen omfatter en aftale med Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen (ETK) om levering af flytteydelser. ETK udbyder flytteydelser på Forsvarets etablissementer, forstået som flytning imellem etablissementer, på etablissementer, nedtagning samt opbevaring. Flytteydelser kan ligeledes indebære, nedtagning, udpakning og opsætning af kontorpladser fordelt på fem (5) regionale delaftaler. Det nærmere indhold og omfang af ydelserne fremgår af Rammeaftalen. Flytteydelser vil skulle udføres på Forsvarets lokationer som fremgår af Aftalebilag 2 - Etablissement oversigt. Antallet af etablissementer vil kunne ændre sig i aftaleperioden. Udbuddet er opdelt geografisk i følgende fem (5) delaftaler: Delaftale 1: Region Nordjylland Delaftale 2: Region Midtjylland Delaftale 3: Region Syddanmark Delaftale 4: Region Sjælland Delaftale 5: Region Hovedstaden Delaftalerne er opdelt geografisk, for at gøre det muligt for mindre og mellemstore lokale virksomheder at byde på opgaven. Der kan afgives tilbud på en eller flere af de udbudte delaftaler. Tilbudsgiver skal i ESPD del ll.A. angive, hvilke delaftaler I ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Der skal afleveres et (1) tilbud per delaftale, som Tilbudsgiver ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen gør opmærksom på, at det er muligt for en Tilbudsgiver at få tildelt alle delaftaler. Rammeaftalen tildeles to Leverandører, som rangeres på en kaskade på baggrund af ETK's tilbudsevaluering, jf. udbudsbetingelsernes pkt. 4. Konkrete ordrer på Rammeaftalen bliver tildelt som følger: Ordrer tildeles den første Leverandør i kaskaden. Såfremt denne Leverandør ikke kan udføre ordren indenfor den fastsatte frist jf. pkt. 9.1, vil den anden Leverandør i kaskaden blive tildelt ordren. Det estimeres, at Rammeaftalen har en økonomisk værdi på 24 mio. i den samlede kon-traktperiode. Værdien er alene udtryk for ETK’s bedste skøn på udbudstidspunktet, der baserer sig på tidligere indkøb samt kommende forventede indkøb. Skønnet er ikke bindende for ETK eller udtryk for en garanteret minimumsomsætning for Leverandøren. ETK har således ikke pligt til at aftage en bestemt mængde. Rammeaftalens maksimale økonomiske værdi i den samlede kontraktperiode udgør i alt 48 mio. DKK. Det maksimale økonomiske omfang udgør en ret til for ETK at købe via Rammeaftalen uanset indkøbsvolumen måtte overstige den estimerede værdi. Den maksimale økonomiske værdi er et udtryk for en samlet økonomisk værdi for alle delaftalerne og benyttes derfor på tværs af delaftalerne. Rammeaftalen ophører uden varsel, såfremt den maksimale værdi overskrides forud for kontraktperiodens ophør. Årsagen til Rammeaftalens maksimale værdi er risikoen for, at ETK’s fremtidige behov over-stiger det på udbudstidspunktet estimerede behov særligt henset til den øgede økonomi og aktivitetsniveau i Forsvaret som følge af Forsvarsforliget for 2024-2033, Aftale om styrkelse af Forsvarets kampkraft af 22. februar 2025 og den nuværende sikkerhedspolitiske situation.

title: Juridiske tjenester innen entrepriserett
description: Kommunen har behov for juridisk bistand innenfor entrepriserett og utbyggingsavtaler/grunneierfinansiering.Mesteparten av oppdragene vil bestå i direkte rådgivning og som advokat ressurs i aktuelle saker. Deler av arbeidet kan bestå i råd og diskusjoner i tillegg til direkte støtte, og ikke minst juridiske råd for å unngå at saker havner i domstolen.Det kan også bli aktuelt med generell kursing / opplæring. Entrepriserett og tilknyttede områder:Kommunen benytter både samspillskontrakt og andre standard entreprisekontrakter. Bistanden skal kunne bestå i juridisk rådgivning i alle faser av et bygge- eller anleggsprosjekt, eks:Kontraktstrategi, valg av kontraktsmodell, utbyggingssaker-rådgivning og oppfølgning av kontrakt gjennom byggefasen ved avslutning av prosjektet med f.eks. sluttoppgjør.

title: Rammeavtale med flere leverandører for rådgivende ingeniørtjenester innen varme-, ventilasjons- og sanitærteknikk (RIV)
description: Bærum kommune, heretter kalt oppdragsgiver, innbyr til åpen anbudskonkurranse i forbindelse med inngåelse av parallelle rammeavtaler for kjøp av rådgivende ingeniørtjenester innen varme-, ventilasjons- og sanitærteknikk.Avtalen vil omfatte forskjellige typer oppdrag innenfor rollen rådgivende ingeniørtjenester knyttet til varme-, ventilasjons- og sanitærteknikk (RIV), i Bærum kommune Eiendom sine prosjekter. Andre tjenestesteder i Bærum kommune har også anledning til å benytte rammeavtalen (særlig aktuelt for Miljøtekniske tjenester, samt Teknologi og digitalisering), men disse andre tjenestestedene har ingen plikt til å benytte denne.Kontraktens varighet er fra og med 15.01.2027 til og med 14.01.2029.Kontraktens varighet er på 2 år med opsjon på forlengelse én eller flere ganger. Avtalen kan bli på totalt 4 år ved utløsing av full opsjon.

title: CONSTRUCTION Indefinite-Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC)
description: Synopsis: CONSTRUCTION Indefinite-Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) The ND Air National Guard, 119th WG, Fargo, ND, is sourcing local (within 250 miles) vendors that are responsible in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) Part 9, a Small Business, and are capable of performing both simple and complex construction services on the ND Air National Guard, 119th Wing. The Government intends to use this information to increase its potential vendor database. This is a Sources Sought notice and shall not be construed in any manner to be an obligation on behalf of the government, or result in any claim for reimbursement of costs for any effort expanded in responding to this request. All work will be in accordance with individual task order requirements, specifications and drawings provided with each project or master specifications. Prospective contractors must be able to respond within 4 hours of the 119th Wing Air National Guard, Fargo, North Dakota in response to emergencies via the main office or a staffed satellite office. The government anticipates award of a minimum of two (2) with a maximum of eight (8) individual MATOC contracts, providing sufficient qualified contractors present offers. These anticipated contracts will consist of a five-year ordering period. Task orders will range between a project magnitude minimum of $2,000.00 to a maximum aggregate value of $25,000,000.00 to any one contractor. All interested contractors must be registered in the System of Award Management (SAM) to be eligible for award. (See internet site https://www.sam.gov/SAM/). Potential contractors should also expect to abide by applicable RFO FAR, Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), Air Force Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (AFFARS), and mandatory procedures. (See internet site https://www.acquisition.gov). Contractors interested in future business with the ND Air National Guard, 119th Wing, must be able to gain access through the appropriate checkpoints and background checks. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) for this acquisition will fall under the following sectors: 22 � Utilities 23 � Construction All interested contractors will provide this office, in writing, with a notice stating their positive intent to submit a proposal as a prime contractor no later than 03 Dec 26. This notification, which shall not exceed five typewritten pages, must include (1) positive statement of intent to bid as a prime contractor, and (2) a completed and signed Sources Sought Information Request Form (see attached) and (3) A listing of projects completed during the past three years, both for government and private industry. The type of project, dollar value, contract number, location and Point of Contact are to be included. Indicate if you were prime of subcontractor, and if subcontractor, provide the name and point of contact for the prime contractor. (4) A brief outline of resources, subcontractors, and key personnel that would be used to accomplish the contract. In the event Small Business contractors are not available for adequate competition for this project, it may be advertised as unrestricted. Information shall be provided via email to: MSgt Tamara Morris at tamara.morris@us.af.mil, Capt Brian Erdmann at brian.erdmann@us.af.mil and SMSgt Rachel Syverson at rachel.syverson@us.af.mil. Include the following in the subject line � Sources Sought W50S88-27-MATOC. No facsimile responses will be honored.

title: Handheld X-Ray Fluorescence for ERDC GSL
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested, and a written solicitation will not be issued. The solicitation is being issued as a Request for Quote (RFQ) with the intent to award as a simplified acquisition. title: Finland – Playground equipment – Kahden uniikin leikkivälineen hankinta Lappeenrannan kaupungille
description: Hankinnan kohteena on kahden uniikin (tarjottuja leikkivälineitä ei ole toimitettu muualle) leikkivälineen toimittaminen asennettuna Lappeenrannan kaupungille. Hankittavat leikkivälineet tulevat Lappeenrantaan satama-alueelle. Ensimmäisen leikkivälineen teemana on "Hevonen" ja toisen leikkivälineen teemana on "Linna". Välineiden tulee mahtua kaikkine rakenneosineen ja putoamisalustoineen tarjouspyynnössä esitetyille tilavarausalueille. Tarjouspyynnöllä haetaan kahta uniikkia, ympäristöön sopivaa ja eri ikäryhmät huomioivia leikkivälinettä. Leikkivälineiden tulee olla myös keskenään yhteensopivia ulkonäöltään. Kilpailutus tehdään käänteisenä kilpailutuksena, eli ranskalaisena urakkana. Käänteisessä kilpailutuksessa hankinnan enimmäishinta on määritelty etukäteen, eli hinnoilla ei kilpailla. Tästä tulee myös termi kiinteähintainen kilpailutus. Tarjoajat siis kilpailevat yksinomaan laatutekijöillä. Hankintaa ei jaeta osiin. Tarjoajan on tarjottava molemmat leikkivälineet. Hankinnan arvo on 280 000 euroa (alv 0%). Sopimuskausi alkaa mahdollisimman pian hankintapäätöksen saatua lainvoiman. Sopimus alkaa aikaisintaan, kun molemmat osapuolet ovat allekirjoittaneet sopimuksen. Sopimus on voimassa siihen asti, kunnes leikkivälineet ovat hyväksytysti toimitettu sekä asennettu ja hyväksytysti käyttöönotettu tilaajan määrittämiin kohteisiin.

title: Denmark – Orthodontic services – Udbud af rammeaftale om tandreguleringsbehandlinger og retentionsforløb for børn og unge i Dragør Kommune
description: Ordregiver udbyder herved rammeaftale om tandreguleringsbehandlinger og retentionsforløb for børn og unge i Dragør Kommune, som er omfattet af Sundhedsstyrelsens kriterier for et kommunalt ortodontisk behandlingstilbud. Rammeaftalen omfatter ortodontiske behandlingsforløb, inkl. nødbehandling og retentionsforløb på de patienter (børn og unge) fra Dragør Kommune, der henvises til – og accepterer – behandlingstilbuddet. Patienterne er på forhånd visiteret af specialtandlæge i ortodonti og vurderet til at være omfattet af Sundhedsstyrelsens kriterier for et kommunalt ortodontisk behandlingstilbud. Derudover kan der på rammeaftalen købes retentionsfremstilling og kontrol af disse. De omfattede behandlinger er inddelt i fire kategorier og nærmere beskrevet i udbudsmaterialets Bilag 2: Kravspecifikation. Ordregiver forventer at henvise ca. 100-120 patienter årligt, men tallet kan variere i både op- og nedadgående retning. Estimatet på 100-120 patienter årligt er et vejledende tal baseret på årgangsstørrelse, forventet forekomst af behandlingskrævende tandstillingsafvigelser samt erfaringer fra tidligere år. Leverandørerne er dog ikke garanteret nogen minimumsmængde af bestillinger. Leverandøren skal dog acceptere at modtage minimum 5 patienter pr. måned og i alt minimum 55 patienter årligt. Der forventes ingen henvisninger i juli måned. Ved aftalens indgåelse er der ophobet en mindre pulje af patienter, der er visiteret af Ordregiver i fjerde kvartal 2026 samt januar 2027 (ca. 10 patienter pr. måned), hvorfor der forventes henvisning af flere patienter ved kontraktopstart, forudsat at leverandøren/leverandørerne kan modtage patienterne. Klinikkerne, hvorpå behandlingen foregår, skal være fysisk beliggende i Danmark og inden for maksimalt 50 km fra Dragør Rådhus, målt som den korteste mulige rute kørt med bil. Afstandsbegrænsningen er begrundet i hensynet til transporttid og transportomkostninger for patienterne. Baggrunden for at ydelserne skal leveres i Danmark er, at der arbejdes efter dansk sundhedslovgivning. Ordregiver vil indgå rammeaftale med de (op til) tre leverandører, som samlet set har afgivet de økonomisk mest fordelagtige tilbud på tværs af de fire prissatte behandlinger i kategori 1-4. Dé tre leverandører, der har afgivet de samlet økonomisk mest fordelagtige tilbud bliver efter-følgende inddelt og rangordnet samlet for behandlinger omfattet af kategori 1, 2 og 3, og særskilt for behandlinger omfattet af kategori 4 ved anvendelsen af kaskademodellerne beskrevet i udbudsbetingelserne. Ved henvisning af patienter vil Ordregiver først tilbyde henvisning til den bedst placerede leverandør efter kaskademodellen for henholdsvis kategorierne 1-3 og kategori 4, og kun hvis denne ikke kan levere, vil Ordregiver gå videre til den næste leverandør i rækken osv. Rammeaftalerne indgås for en periode på to (2) år med mulighed for at Ordregiver kan forlænge aftaleperioden to gange med ét (1) år. Det anslåede antal behandlingsforløb i kategori 1-4, der skal leveres i henhold til rammeaftalen, er 480 behandlinger, og det maksimale samlede antal behandlingsforløb i kategori 1-4, der skal leveres i henhold til rammeaftalen, er 600 behandlinger.

title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Clathrate Therapeutics Platform
description: This technology from scientists at Los Alamos National Laboratory represents a novel platform for improving the safety and effectiveness of therapeutic gas-based treatments by enabling controlled, localized delivery at the site of disease. By addressing longstanding challenges associated with systemic exposure and dosing precision, the platform enhances the clinical viability of gas therapies across high-value markets such as oncology, cardiovascular care, and regenerative medicine. In addition, the inclusion of a complementary predictive modeling capability supports treatment optimization and development efficiency, reducing technical risk and accelerating translation. Together, these capabilities position the technology as a differentiated and scalable solution that can unlock new commercial opportunities in areas where gas-based therapeutics have shown promise but faced delivery limitations. The Opportunity: Therapeutic gases have demonstrated meaningful biological effects across oncology, cardiovascular disease, neuroprotection and regenerative medicine, yet their clinical adoption has been limited by a fundamental challenge: safe, controlled and localized delivery. Existing approaches often result in rapid release, systemic exposure or narrow therapeutic windows, creating safety, regulatory and development barriers. The Clathrate Therapeutics Platform addresses this unmet need by positioning gas-based therapies as programmable, targetable and commercially viable treatment modalities. By enabling more precise control over where and how therapeutic gases are delivered, the platform has the potential to unlock new product categories, enhance combination treatment strategies and accelerate translation of gas-based therapeutics into high-value clinical markets. How it Works: The Clathrate Therapeutics Platform uses a proprietary, controlled-release system designed to localize therapeutic gases at the intended treatment site rather than allowing them to disperse systemically. This technology temporarily stabilizes the gas within a biocompatible structure that gradually releases it under physiological conditions, enabling sustained and targeted exposure. This controlled release approach is designed to support therapeutic concentrations where needed while limiting circulating levels elsewhere in the body. An integrated computational modeling capability further supports optimization of dosing profiles and treatment parameters, helping guide development decisions prior to in vivo studies. Key Advantages: Localized delivery: Targets therapeutic gases to the intended site while minimizing systemic exposure. Controlled release: Designed for sustained, tunable dosing under physiological conditions. Improved safety margin: Aims to separate therapeutic effect from toxicity risk. Platform versatility: Applicable across oncology, cardiovascular, neurological and regenerative indications. Development optimization: Supported by predictive modeling to guide dose and design decisions. Partnership-ready architecture: Suitable for integration with drug-device combinations and existing treatment modalities. Market Applications: Oncology Therapeutics Industry Cardiovascular and Vascular Medicine Industry Neurology and Neurodegenerative Disease Sector Regenerative Medicine and Tissue Engineering Industry Medical Device and Drug-Device Combination Companies Biotechnology and Specialty Pharma Companies Computational Drug Development and Modeling Firms Development Status: TRL 2 US patent pending LA-UR-26-22810 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. LANL�s licensing program focuses on moving inventions developed by our researchers to commercial innovations. Patented and patent pending inventions and copyrighted software are available to existing and start-up companies through exclusive and non-exclusive licensing agreements. For specific discussions, please contact licensing@lanl.gov. title: 655-23-101 Site Water Loop Replacement
description: The project�s general scope of work is to furnish all tools, equipment, material, permits, labor, supervision, and all other necessary resources to accomplish the following work: This project replaces a portion of the existing campus water loop piping and existing campus water loop isolation valves. The project also includes installing a water booster pump that will be powered by a new equipment branch of emergency power in Building 22. For the new equipment branch of emergency power to be added, new wiring will feed from Building 19 (generator building) utilizing an existing underground conduit to Building 22 to feed a new emergency power distribution panel which will replace the existing emergency power distribution panel that does not meet code requirements. Installation of a new automatic transfer switch and panelboard along with wiring and conduits will be required to create the new equipment branch of emergency power. The project will also disturb many portions of the existing asphalt roadways and parking lots as well as concrete sidewalks and curbing due to excavation work. The contractor shall patch or replace asphalt and concrete as shown on the drawings and repair any areas of the landscaping and lawn that get disturbed during the project. The existing campus water loop piping is located below many of the existing campus roadways and sidewalks, and it is anticipated that most of the new piping will be as well. Therefore, this project shall be completed in phases to allow campus access for employees and Veterans and maintain water service until a tie-in to an existing building service pipe is to take place. If a shutdown of water service for any building is required during the duration of the project, it must be coordinated with the COR. Period of performance is 300 calendar days from receipt of the Notice to Proceed.
